item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); print(json.dumps([evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests],sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"from work import evaluate; import copy, json; r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}; e=[{'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1},'value':{'b':2,'a':1},'verified':True},{'source':'b','claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1},'value':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}]; p={'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}; before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); assert evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]}; assert (r,e,p)==before; assert evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},e,p)['unknowns']==['x']; assert evaluate(r,[dict(e[0],verified=False)],p)['unknowns']==['no matching evidence']; assert evaluate(r,[dict(e[0],value=True),dict(e[1],value=False)],p)=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}; assert evaluate(r,[dict(e[0],value=False)],p)['status']=='unsupported'; assert evaluate(r,[e[0],dict(e[1],supersedes=['a'],value=3)],p)=={'status':'supported','value':3,'sources':['b'],'unknowns':[]}; print('ok')\"]}}]}"}
